title: Anger as misrepresentation from birth; the authoritarian family and state
summary: Asked about career frustrations, Gil says anger comes from lifelong misrepresentation by family, church and state.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Life philosophy: faith, karma and how to live

blocks.x: Which brings me up to another question I suppose right now and that is that I'm sure that much of this must come, most of this anger came about as a result of various frustrations in your career.

What the anger comes from is the total misrepresentation that every being has to endure from the time it is born. That's why everybody is angry basically. It's been brought to light and identified and all that with whatever the circumstances are. And you can turn it on or you can use it as a vehicle for your anger. You use a certain thing as a vehicle for that anger. A certain thing happens to you so you let yourself go and a lot of anger to be pointed at something that shouldn't get you angry anyway. Even though that particular thing, incident or situation is not the basis of your anger, it's a way of releasing the anger that piles up inside of you from the time you are born by not getting what you want when you want it. And getting what you want when you don't want it or getting what you don't want when you want it. Or getting what you don't want when you don't want it. Apparently not getting it at the natural time can cause that.
And all the training you get, toilet training can cause it. This kind of tension builds the muscles ( ?) and it's hard for you to let it go.
So we suffer from misrepresentation all the way clear out through our Congress I guess. But our Congress....
Oh don't stop at the Congress. All the way through our President. (LAUGHTER).
And that's all supported by the individual family which echoes that same thing to their children because they don't want their neighbors to think that they're different, right?

So there's no way, in this particular set up that civilization has now, we can't say that thing should be changed like that because it would cause havoc. That's the problem. To try to raise a child, let a child raise itself in a natural self- regulatory manner, could lead to havoc. In a neighborhood or household or state or whatever, whatever the situation is, is based on this other particular anti-life type of situation.
All organised things that belong to us, personal, private things that shouldn't belong to
anybody but us and have been organised to the public thing like religion and a notion and democracy.

Nations not based on the work you do but democracy, based on the little man. The authoritarian family and echoes the state and does all those things to you and misrepresents to you in an innocent or even if it's calculated manner, they do it because it has to be done.

Parents for instance, they say, well this has to be done. You must do that. For example, the mother says to the child, you're a certain age now, you can no longer associate with that person because you have a life to lead now.
Is that the way you were brought up?
